trained_on: 12,500 face-to-face-dialogue utterances (soft targets: text-LLM votes and a cue model) and 600 dialogue tags by ear (weight 20); 117 tagged Swedish radio-interview utterances (weight 20); 5,423 utterances of a three-party quiz game (Swedish and English, far-field microphone-array beams): 300 tags by ear (weight 20) and weak labels from the dialogue structure and lexical cues for the rest (weight 1)
evaluation: 5-fold CV by recording (one quiz game per fold), certain vs uncertain: face-to-face dialogue 430 tags AUC 0.817 (0.822 with the cue model); radio interviews 73 tags 0.793 (0.848); quiz game 238 tags 0.696 (the v3 recipe + the interview tags on the same folds: 0.799 / 0.807 / 0.696)
